label: failed-tax-calculation-error
content:
# Adds Failed Tax Calculation error

## What’s new

Introduces a new error code and message that’s returned when automatic tax fails to calculate.

This change affects the following APIs:

- [Create a calculation](https://docs.stripe.com/api/tax/calculations/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)
- [Preview a calculation](https://docs.stripe.com/api/tax/calculations/preview.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)
- [Finalize an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/finalize.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)
- [Pay an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/pay.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)
- [Retrieve an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/retrieve.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)
- [Create a subscription](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)
- [Update a subscription](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)

If you encounter this error, [contact Stripe Support](https://support.stripe.com/contact).

## Impact

If your integration handles specific error codes from APIs with automatic tax, you must update your error handling logic to also handle the `failed_tax_calculation` error code, which indicates that the tax calculation couldn’t be completed.

2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2026-09-30.endive`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5. If you use Connect, [test your Connect integration](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).
